evidenceType: retained desktop Debug-shell captures using Shipping shader policy

shippingDiagnostics.interpretation: Failure/recovery event counts are not runtime evidence in these Shipping-policy manifests because those counters were compiled out.

separateDiagnosticCounterEvidence.counterOutcome: All event/overflow/recovery/mask counters compare equal and are zero in these manifests. The five reason-object primary pixel aggregate fields compare equal per pair; values are recorded per fixture below.
separateDiagnosticCounterEvidence.limitation: Separate Diagnostic-policy evidence only; do not attribute these counters to Shipping-policy captures.

limitations: The captures identify an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU and are desktop Debug-shell evidence, not physical-phone or Release performance evidence.
Pixel tolerance and exact PNG hashes establish only the recorded capture comparisons; they do not establish visual acceptability or gameplay quality.
The staged-primary allocation figures are reported logical/padded/allocation metadata. DRAM traffic was explicitly not measured.
Timing comparisons failed the retained 2% threshold. Their capture-median basis is not a sustained-performance claim.
